PR: Let XR and claim conditions persist observed generation [closed]
### Description of your changes

Without this the generation is never persisted to the API server. This causes the condition equality check to fail when MarkCondition is called, so the conditions get a new LastTransitionTime on every reconcile.

Little follow-on to https://github.com/crossplane/crossplane/pull/6442 that I noticed while working on https://github.com/crossplane/crossplane/pull/6489. Breaking it out into its own PR so it doesn't block on that mega-PR.
